testcase.name: Scale and translate: exact 'from' at progress 0 and exact 'to' at progress 1 (and after a ONCE drive); easing is applied to the drive's progress
Random compositions of up to 6 steps (fixed, spin, scale, translate) on random anchors match the independent matrix oracle within the tolerance
Shared motions: one Motion value reused by layers with different visibility timings gives the same pose in every layer (transform grouping)
The frame's pose is anchor.then(motion.poseAt(local)) and every point is pose.toWorld(local point), bit for bit (normative order)
Spin: right-handed about the axis by 2 pi (phase + turns e); a quarter turn about +Y maps +X to -Z; whole turns and negative turns; equals the M1 Quat.axisAngle rotation within the tolerance
Composition order: m.then(child) applies the child first (M1 Pose.then); translate-then-spin differs from spin-then-translate; both match the independent matrix oracle
Inverted transforms: fixed(p).then(fixed(p.inverse())) is the identity within the tolerance; an inverse anchor maps world points back to local ones
Finite results: an unrepresentable composed scale or translation (M1 Pose.then) or a non-finite world point gives ArithmeticException, and no frame is returned
